Load data

# Standard data
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/df.RDS") 

# KPC Plasmids 
KPC_info_clusters <- readRDS("./data/KPC_plasmid/KPC_containing_clusters_mat.RDS") %>% as.data.frame 
## KPC containing clusters
KPC_containing_clusters <- KPC_info_clusters %>% `colnames<-`(paste0(colnames(.),"_KPC")) %>% {ifelse(.=="KPC Plasmid",1,0)} %>% as.data.frame%>% select_if(colSums(.)>0)
KPC_clusters <- colnames(KPC_containing_clusters)
## Non KPC clusters
Non_KPC_clusters <- KPC_info_clusters %>% `colnames<-`(paste0(colnames(.),"_non_KPC")) %>% {ifelse(.=="Non-KPC plasmid",1,0)} %>% as.data.frame %>% select_if(colSums(.)>0)
## Merge data
df <- left_join(df,KPC_containing_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.))) %>% left_join(Non_KPC_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.)))

# Mobtyper
mobsuite_contigs <- readRDS("./data/mobsuite/mobsuite_contigs.RDS")
kpc_locations <- read_delim("./data/KPC_blast/KPC_blast_master.txt") 
mobtyper <- readRDS("./data/mobsuite/mobtyper.RDS")
isolates_KPC_plasmid <- lapply(rownames(KPC_containing_clusters),FUN=function(x){ 
  KPC_plasmid <-  KPC_containing_clusters %>% subset(rownames(.) ==x) %>% colSums(.) %>% subset(.>0) %>% names %>% gsub("_KPC","",.)
  if(is_empty(KPC_plasmid)){
    KPC_plasmid <- 'none'
  }
  names(KPC_plasmid) <- x 
  return(KPC_plasmid)
}) %>% unlist

mobtyper$KPC_plasmid <- apply(mobtyper,MARGIN=1,FUN=function(x){
  isolate <- x[['isolate_no']]
  isolate_KPC_plasmid <- subset(isolates_KPC_plasmid,names(isolates_KPC_plasmid)==isolate)
  x[['primary_cluster_id']] == isolate_KPC_plasmid
  
})
mobtyper$gc_perc <- mobtyper$gc*100
 
# Join 
df <- left_join(df,KPC_containing_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.)))    

# KPC data
# Load blast data 
KPC_data <- read.table("./data/KPC_blast/KPC_blast_master.txt",header = T)  
KPC_data$KPC_allele <- paste0("bla",str_split(KPC_data$sseqid,"\\|",simplify = T) %>% .[,ncol(.)])
df <- left_join(df,KPC_data %>% select(isolate_no,KPC_allele))
df$KPC_allele <- ifelse(is.na(df$KPC_allele),"No blaKPC",df$KPC_allele) 
mobtyper <- left_join(mobtyper,df %>% select(isolate_no,KPC_allele,clade_I))

A. KPC plasmid frequency across cluster frequency

mobtyper_sum <- mobtyper %>% group_by(primary_cluster_id) %>% summarise(n=n(),KPC_plasmid = sum(KPC_plasmid),Non_KPC_plasmid = n-KPC_plasmid)  
KPC_plasmids <- subset(mobtyper_sum,KPC_plasmid>0) %>% arrange(-KPC_plasmid) %>%  .$primary_cluster_id
 
KPC_plasmid_scale <-  scale_fill_manual(breaks = c(T,F),values=c("red","gray"),labels = c("Yes","No"),name = "<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>-containing",guide = guide_legend(nrow=1, title.position = "top", label.position = "right"))


mobtyper_KPC_plasmids_all <- mobtyper %>% subset(primary_cluster_id %in% KPC_plasmids) 
mobtyper_KPC_plasmids_all$primary_cluster_id <- factor(mobtyper_KPC_plasmids_all$primary_cluster_id,levels=KPC_plasmids) 

# Label
min_sep <- 10       # Minimum vertical distance between labels
small_seg <- 1.5     # Segments of size <= 1 get outside labels
outside_offset <- 8.5

dataset_for_label <- mobtyper_KPC_plasmids_all %>%
  filter(primary_cluster_id %in% KPC_plasmids) %>%
  count(primary_cluster_id, clade_I, KPC_plasmid) %>%
  # Pivot wider
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = KPC_plasmid,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(
    TRUE_n  = `TRUE`,
    FALSE_n = `FALSE`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = TRUE_n + FALSE_n,

    # Default positions
    y_true  = TRUE_n / 2,
    y_false = TRUE_n + FALSE_n / 2,

    # Only bars with both segments need adjustment
    two_segments = TRUE_n > 0 & FALSE_n > 0,

    # Put tiny upper segments above the bar
    y_false = if_else(
      FALSE_n <= small_seg & two_segments,
      total + outside_offset,
      y_false
    ),

    # Otherwise ensure labels are separated
    sep = y_false - y_true,

    y_false = if_else(
      two_segments &
        FALSE_n > small_seg &
        sep < min_sep,
      y_false + (min_sep - sep),
      y_false
    )
  )

## Label dataset
label_df <- dataset_for_label %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(TRUE_n, FALSE_n),
    names_to = "group",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    KPC_plasmid = group == "TRUE_n",
    y = if_else(KPC_plasmid, y_true, y_false)
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 0)


# Figure

A <-  ggplot(mobtyper_KPC_plasmids_all,
  aes(
    x = primary_cluster_id,
    fill = KPC_plasmid
  )
) +
  geom_bar() +
  KPC_plasmid_scale +
  theme_bw_me +
  labs(
    x = "Primary MOB-cluster",
    y = "Isolates",
    fill = "<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>-containing plasmid"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_df,
    aes(
      x = primary_cluster_id,
      y = y,
      label = n
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  facet_grid(~clade_I) +
  s_figure_5_format

A

E. KPC contig size

mobsuite_contigs$KPC_contig <- mobsuite_contigs$contig_id %in% kpc_locations$qseqid

get_isolates_KPC_plasmids_df <- function(isolate,mobsuite_contigs,isolates_KPC_plasmid){
  KPC_plasmid <- isolates_KPC_plasmid %>% subset(names(.) == isolate)  
  subset(mobsuite_contigs,isolate_no == isolate & primary_cluster_id == KPC_plasmid)
}

KPC_containing_isolates <- subset(df,KPC_allele !="$KPC_allele") %>% .$isolate_no
KPC_contig_data <- lapply(KPC_containing_isolates,get_isolates_KPC_plasmids_df,mobsuite_contigs,isolates_KPC_plasmid) %>% do.call(rbind,.)
KPC_contig_data$primary_cluster_id <- factor(KPC_contig_data$primary_cluster_id,levels = KPC_plasmids)

E <-  ggplot(data=KPC_contig_data  ,aes(x=forcats::fct_infreq(primary_cluster_id),fill=KPC_contig),y=size) + geom_boxplot(aes(y=size), linewidth = 0.25, outlier.size = 0.33)  + KPC_plasmid_scale + 
  theme_bw_me  + 
  labs(x="",y="Contig size (bp)",fill="blaKPC-containing plasmid")  + geom_hline(yintercept = 10000,linetype = 2,linewidth = 0.5)  + scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,10000,25000,50000,75000,100000,120000)) + s_figure_5_format

E

H. Replicon type

rep_type_matrix <- mobtyper %>% subset(primary_cluster_id %in% KPC_plasmids) %>% select(isolate_no,primary_cluster_id,rep_types)%>%
  separate_rows(rep_types,sep=",") %>%
  group_by(primary_cluster_id,rep_types) %>%
  summarise(n=n(),.groups='drop') %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(rep_types = recode(rep_types,"-" = 'Absent')) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = rep_types,values_from = n,values_fill = 0) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% `rownames<-`(.$primary_cluster_id)  %>% select(-primary_cluster_id)  

rep_type_matrix <- rep_type_matrix[match(KPC_plasmids, rownames(rep_type_matrix)), , drop = FALSE]

H <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(rep_type_matrix, col = c('white','red'), name = 'Count',
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (rep_type_matrix[i, j] > 0) {
      grid.text(sprintf("%.3s", rep_type_matrix[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 6))
    }
  },
  show_heatmap_legend = F, cluster_rows = F, show_column_dend = T,
  column_title = "Replicon type", column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  height = unit(3.4, "cm"), width = ncol(rep_type_matrix) * unit(0.47, "cm"),
  column_names_max_height = unit(3.1, "cm"),
  column_dend_height = unit(0.6, "cm"))
H

maxchar <- colnames(rep_type_matrix) %>% sapply(nchar) %>% max
